column1: # Source: JAX jax/_src/lax/**/*.py at each release tag (@jax2025laxprimitives)
# Epistemic: measured (AST-counted module-level <name>_p Primitive definitions across official JAX release tags)
# Method: scripted (AST-counted module-level <name>_p Primitive bindings across jax/_src/lax/**/*.py at each official JAX GitHub release tag)

# Computation: Count of module-level ast.Assign and ast.AnnAssign bindings matching <name>_p = ... (including direct Primitive/core.Primitive/AxisPrimitive constructors and helper wrappers such as standard_primitive and linalg_primitive) across jax/_src/lax/**/*.py at each tag.
#   release: string [tag] — Official JAX GitHub release tag
#   date: date [ISO-8601 date] — GitHub release publication date for the tag
#   primitives: integer [primitives] — Count of module-level lax Primitive definitions (<name>_p bindings) in jax/_src/lax
# Notes: Dates record official GitHub release publication timestamps for each tag.
